confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Kuala Lumpur price levels, projected forward from remembered prices to July 2026; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and hostel anchors are moderately certain, hotel anchors vary widely by neighbourhood, and the cocktail and wine anchors were set from their local relationship to draft beer because direct knowledge is weaker. USD figures depend on recent ringgit-dollar rates. The FX value is the 15 October 2026 RBA figure as reported in search results citing the RBA exchange-rates page; I could not open that page or the F11.1 CSV to confirm it directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Southeast Asian capital basis: food and budget rooms roughly in line with or somewhat above Bangkok, well below Singapore. Alcohol is priced above Bangkok levels because of Malaysian excise taxes.
